front: What is Zustand in one sentence?
back: Minimal client-state library for React — store outside the component tree with selective subscriptions — when Redux is overkill.

front: Explain the mental model of Zustand (how the system thinks).
back: Zustand holds state in a vanilla store (works without React). Components subscribe to slices; only subscribers to changed keys re-render. No Provider required (unlike Context performance traps).

front: Which standard commands / workflow do you use for Zustand?
back: On server: new store per request. On client: hydrate once from serialized snapshot or accept flash.

front: When should you NOT use Zustand?
back: Server-fetched lists with cache invalidation — TanStack Query / RTK Query. Complex event-sourced domain — Redux Toolkit + RTK Query or explicit event store. Cross-tab sync requirements — add BroadcastChannel or use URL/server state.
